# SurgiMac

> > SurgiMac is a comprehensive medical and dental supply distributor offering surgical instruments, dental tools, infection control products, and healthcare equipment from leading manufacturers.

SurgiMac specializes in professional-grade dental instruments (including Pro Series, Air Series, and Hexa Series lines), surgical tools, infection control solutions from brands like PDI and Metrex, and medical equipment from Dynarex, Septodont, and McKesson. The company serves dental practices, surgical centers, and healthcare facilities with products ranging from scalers and forceps to patient monitors and mobility aids.

## Key Topics

- Dental Instruments
- Surgical Tools
- SurgiMac Pro Series
- SurgiMac Air Series
- Dynarex Medical Equipment
- Infection Control & Disinfection
- PDI & Metrex Products
- Septodont Dental Anesthetics
- Stainless Steel Instruments
- Ergonomic Handle Design
- IV Administration Supplies
- Patient Mobility & Safety
- Wound Care Products
- Root Canal Endodontics
- Healthcare Equipment
